```{r}
library(metrosp)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

theme_metro <- theme_minimal(base_family = "Lato", base_size = 11) +
  theme_sub_panel(
    grid.minor = element_blank()
  ) +
  theme_sub_axis_x(
    line = element_line(color = "gray40", linewidth = 0.5),
    ticks = element_line(color = "gray40")
  )

```

# Visual inspection

```{r}
plot_metric <- function(dat, metric) {

  subdat <- dplyr::filter(dat, metric_abb == !!metric)

  ggplot(subdat, aes(date, value)) +
    geom_line() +
    facet_wrap(vars(line_number)) +
    labs(
      title = stringr::str_glue("Plotting: {metric}"),
      x = NULL,
      y = NULL
    ) +
    theme_metro


}
```

```{r}
valid_metrics <- unique(passengers_entrance$metric_abb)

plot_metric(passengers_entrance, valid_metrics[5])
```
